description: Loam's profile refusals, each a base manifest with `set` and `remove` applied by RFC 6901 pointer, run through readManifest. `code` and `key` are the refusal's, `suggestion` a part of its text. spec/plugin-manifest.json holds the core's cases; these hold what Loam narrows.

plugin.title: Hello
plugin.description: One command, a sidebar list and a main view: the reference app.

grants.name: clock
grants.reason: Stamps each greeting with the command context's clock.

commands.name: hello-greet
commands.title: Greet someone
commands.description: Greet someone and remember the name.

commands.name: hello-list
commands.title: List greetings
commands.description: List the names greeted, as a sidebar list.

commands.name: hello-forget
commands.title: Forget a name
commands.description: Remove a greeted name; the undo of hello-greet.
